## Current authoritative state

CYAX-0155 is currently **closed with reason Completed**, and its Project item has **Status: Done**. PR #156 is **merged** into `vmm` at commit `f0013552cd69a93221464e9c8ccfd56339f39052`. These are authoritative within their respective scopes: Issues/Projects represent live work state, while the merged commit represents repository state. (Sources: `issue-155-current`, `pr-156`, `sdd-contract-at-merge`)

This establishes the recorded current status. It does **not**, by itself, prove that every earlier workflow condition was fulfilled.

## Historical instruction and unresolved condition

After the PR merged, the durable checkpoint stated that the repository-side privacy boundary was active, but instructed:

> Keep #155 open until the Research & Chats saved Project view/filter is configured.

The same checkpoint said the available tooling could neither configure nor directly verify that Projects-v2 view. PR #156 also expressly claimed no Project mutation. (Sources: `issue-155-checkpoint`, `pr-156`)

This was a remaining workflow/project-configuration condition, not an unimplemented repository requirement. The approved specification required the repository control plane to support a saved Research & Chats view without creating a second ledger; its acceptance language said such a view **can be configured**, not that a concrete view must exist in the repository. (Source: `spec-0155`)

## Implementation evidence

The merged squash commit changed the repository contracts, SDD, human guide, and approved specification. The guide defines Research & Chats as a saved view over existing Project items and the normal Status field, but does not identify an actual configured view or filter. (Sources: `pr-156-merge-commit`, `checkpoint-guide-at-merge`, `agents-contract-at-merge`)

Thus, durable evidence supports completion of the repository implementation and the privacy/publication rules. It does not prove completion of the separate Project UI configuration.

## Later event and what it proves

At `2026-09-11T01:09:18Z`, `vmmhep` closed Issue #155. That event proves the issue was deliberately closed by that actor and explains the current closed state. It contains no reason, explanatory text, or commit reference. The merge commit also contains no automatic-closing keyword. (Sources: `issue-155-closure-event`, `pr-156-merge-commit`)

Inference: the later closure operationally displaced the historical instruction to keep the issue open. However, the frozen evidence is insufficient to infer *why* it was closed.

I explicitly abstain from claiming that the saved view was configured or that the condition was formally waived or superseded. The bounded search found no later durable public artifact documenting either outcome. (Source: `closure-search`)

## What remains uncertain

The following remain unknown:

- Whether a concrete Research & Chats saved view/filter was ever configured.
- Whether someone verified its use of the existing Project items, Status field, and sanitized metadata.
- Whether closure reflected successful configuration, an intentional waiver, a changed decision, or an accidental/premature action.
- Whether relevant non-public or post-snapshot evidence exists; `closure-search` proves absence only within its captured scope through `2026-09-13T04:35:55Z`.

## Next valid verification or action

Directly inspect the CYAxiverse Research & Development Project with Projects-v2 read access and verify whether the Research & Chats saved view/filter exists and conforms to the approved design. Then:

- If it exists, record a durable sanitized checkpoint identifying the verified configuration.
- If it does not exist, configure it through authorized Projects-v2 controls and document completion; if configuration cannot proceed, reopen or otherwise correct the work state so it does not imply verified completion.

Until that verification occurs, **Closed/Completed and Done are the authoritative recorded work state, while fulfillment or supersession of the saved-view condition is unproven**.
